div.span:
Bucketed Batch Drawing (makeBuckets):
Groups particles into color & alpha bins (colors * alphas)
Minimizes Canvas context state changes

buckets.flush(ctx, colors):
Executes single batch fillRect / fillPath per bucket
Guarantees solid 60 fps on mid-tier mobile GPUs

Pointer Move / Drag:
Updates yaw velocity (vy) & pitch velocity (vx)
Inertia momentum with damping decay (* 0.94 / frame)

prefers-reduced-motion Gate:
Pauses requestAnimationFrame loop; renders static beautiful projection

Pointer Proximity Parting:
Dots within 90px displace outward along repulsion vector

Click / Tap Shockwave:
Expands spherical wave radius r_ripple at 320 px/sec
Displaces dot positions sinusoidally with decaying amplitude

Fibonacci Spiral on Sphere:
y = 1 - ((i + 0.5) / n) * 2
r = sqrt(1 - y*y), theta = golden * i + jitter
Point coordinates: (x, y, z)

Directional Light Vector:
LIGHT = [0.5, -0.72, 0.48] normalized
lit = dot(point, LIGHT)
density = 0.1 + 0.9 * smooth(-0.7, 0.75, lit)

Color Gradient Ramp:
Light Mode: Card -> Ink -> Accent
Dark Mode: Panel -> Accent -> Mint

Lagoon Reference Palette:
• Accent: #1aa59a
• Button: #123b3a
• Mint: #d2efe9
• Cream: #efeccd
